text: I need the same Rooftop Jazz promo made in two versions, and I’m probably over-explaining because I want to be clear about what I mean. I’m a little worried about how it will look when it’s shown in such different places. The scene should be a rooftop at sunset with musicians playing, and somewhere in all of this the practical bit is that both videos need to be 10 seconds long, with one in 9:16 for Stories and the other in 16:9 for a venue screen. For the sound, I want mellow jazz in both versions and no voiceover. The text to show is 'Rooftop Jazz', '18 July 2026' and 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'. Please make both versions fill the frame and keep all the text readable.
